title: Nebraska cattlemen work with U.S.-based Coupang to access overseas markets
summary: Nebraska cattle producers partner with Coupang to export premium beef directly to South Korea via Rocket Fresh, opening high-value global market access.
body_markdown:
Nebraska cattle ranchers are expanding their international reach through a new direct-sourcing initiative with[Coupang, Inc.](https://www.aboutcoupang.com/how-coupang-american-tech-company-went-global/) , a U.S. technology and retail Fortune 150 company. Created in partnership with Omaha-based[Nebraska Beef Ltd.](https://nbeef.com/) , the initiative marks Coupang’s first direct-sourcing program for U.S. beef, creating an immediate export pathway for premium Nebraska beef to Korea — the world’s top market for U.S. meat exports.


The initiative builds on ongoing collaboration among Coupang, Nebraska state representatives, and key industry organizations, including the Nebraska Beef Council and Nebraska Cattlemen, which focuses on supporting Nebraska’s livestock sector.


“Coupang is proud to launch our first direct-sourcing program for U.S. beef right here in Nebraska,” said Coupang Chief Global Affairs Officer Robert Porter. “Nebraska ranchers produce world-class beef, and Coupang’s direct-sourcing infrastructure makes it easy for local cattlemen to tap into high-demand international markets, unlock valuable new revenue streams and strengthen American agricultural trade on the global stage.”


**Initiative opens new markets for high-quality Nebraska beef**


Nebraska Governor Jim Pillen highlighted the state’s reputation for producing some of the highest-quality beef in the world and the new opportunities this initiative creates for local cattle producers.


“Nebraska is home to the finest beef in the world, produced by generations of ranchers and cattle producers who are committed to quality, innovation and stewardship,” said Governor Pillen. “This initiative opens new doors for Nebraska beef to reach consumers abroad, creating valuable market opportunities for our producers and strengthening an industry that is at the heart of our state’s economy. When Nebraska producers have greater access to global customers, it means more growth, more investment and more opportunity for rural communities across our state.”


Coupang, Inc. representatives meet with Nebraska Governor Jim Pillen


Korea is currently the premier destination for U.S. red meat exports, valued at $2.2 billion in 2025, according to the U.S. Meat Export Federation. The country represents a rapidly growing market for U.S. beef, with the category’s sales on Coupang climbing over 63% year-to-date in 2026. Coupang, which works with thousands of American businesses and brands to sell their goods overseas, generated more than $64 million in U.S. meat exports to Korea in 2025 alone.


**Coupang’s global fulfillment and logistics network moves beef from farm to table at speed**


Coupang’s fulfillment and logistics network allows Nebraska beef to move efficiently to consumers in Asia. Once the meat arrives in Korea, customer orders are delivered through Rocket Fresh, the country’s leading grocer. This efficiency provides American producers the opportunity to offer high-value perishable agricultural goods, which are sensitive to transit times, to millions of customers.


Coupang’s direct-sourcing model – which allows the company to purchase agriculture goods directly from the source – offers an efficient, direct bridge connecting U.S. producers straight to end consumers in Asia. This link allows American producers to capitalize on high international demand for specialized cuts — including LA style ribs and grilling cuts such as oyster blade and chuck eye roll — which carry premium margins in Asian markets, maximizing the total value returned to American livestock operations.


In 2025 alone, Coupang helped drive the export and sale of more than $5 billion in American goods and services across more than 190 countries and territories, helping thousands of U.S. small businesses, family enterprises and agricultural producers expand their reach globally.


## Frequently asked questions


What is Coupang’s new direct-sourcing initiative with Nebraska cattle ranchers?


It is Coupang’s first direct-sourcing program for U.S. beef, created in partnership with Omaha-based Nebraska Beef Ltd. The initiative establishes an immediate export pathway for premium Nebraska beef to reach consumers in South Korea by purchasing agricultural products directly from local producers.


How is the beef delivered to consumers while maintaining freshness?


The beef travels through Coupang’s fulfillment and logistics network directly to South Korea, where orders are fulfilled through Rocket Fresh, the country's leading online grocer. This rapid delivery model reduces transit times for perishable meat products, ensuring high-value agricultural goods reach millions of customers fresh.


Why is South Korea a key target market for Nebraska beef?


South Korea is the world’s top market for U.S. red meat exports, accounting for $2.2 billion in exports in 2025 according to the U.S. Meat Export Federation. Demand continues to expand rapidly, with U.S. beef sales on Coupang growing by more than 63% year-to-date in 2026.
